interface.title: CPRD Extractor v1.0 (University of Oxford)
interface.field: Epidemiology / UK electronic health record research (CPRD Aurum primary care with linked HES and ONS data)
interface.stage_of_work: Study set-up and data preparation: defining code lists, extracting records, building a cohort, and exporting for analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Turning a clinical concept into reviewed code lists, pulling the matching primary-care, hospital and death records for a patient population, narrowing them to a cohort with an attrition funnel, and exporting the result as CSV or Parquet.

data.note: The app started in '🧪 Mock Data (Testing)' mode by itself: 500 synthetic patients, 2,000 observations, 1,500 drug issues and 800 HES APC records (screens/004.webp). The uploaded test file snomed_codes.csv (5 codes in column snomed_code) was also used. Because the data are synthetic, some lookups come back empty. Heart failure SNOMED codes are not in the mock EMIS dictionary. SGLT2 drugs are not in the mock product dictionary. The Stage 5 medcodeids (1000000/1000001) and the manual ONS I50 codes matched no records. One mistake in the test file: it labels 60573004 as 'Essential hypertension', but that code is aortic stenosis.

tree.general: Assemble a disease-defined patient population from routine health records and export it for analysis
tree.specific: In Mock Data mode: attempt a heart-failure code list (only the aortic-stenosis control code 60573004 matched the mock dictionary, so the matched list and review workbook hold aortic-stenosis codes), extract heart-failure records with the built-in disease libraries, extract antihypertensive prescriptions (SGLT2 drugs are absent from the mock product dictionary), pull HES/ONS records, apply age, registration and linkage criteria in the Cohort Builder, and export as CSV/Parquet
